notes: Ten synthetic save files, each present with probability 0.6, with random text fields and name indices 0..6 into two synthetic string tables; directory mode word 0, 1 or 0x100. The file name buffer and index locals live on the stack, so the stubs log the formats and arguments of sprintf (0xa4342), the handle, size and non-stack destination of each read (0xa79d4, which copies its bytes from a data queue), the closed handle (0xa7990) and the mode passed to 0x278c0. copy_string_9d749 runs for real.
